[https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suhVOaG1](https://coda.io/d/_d0SvdI3KSto/_suhVOaG1)‘s "The Great Red Dragon and the Woman Clothed in the Sun" depicts a powerful struggle between good and evil, drawing inspiration from the Book of Revelation. The painting features a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet, who is threatened by a seven-headed, ten-horned red dragon representing Satan.
